The '''King of Mon Cala''' was the title held by the ruler of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]] was the eighty-second [[King/Legends|King]] of Mon Cala, with his son, [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], succeeding him as the eighty-third.<ref name="Strongholds" />
